name: Zephyr Squad
description: Zephyr Squad is Jira-native test-management software for designing tests, organizing cycles, recording executions and reporting quality work inside Jira. It is a separate SmartBear product from Zephyr Scale, with a different legacy Cloud API and credential model.
agentUseSummary: Zephyr Squad cannot currently be connected as a Relay Marketplace provider. SmartBear documents user-bound access and secret keys but sends implementers to a legacy client-rendered Apiary contract for request signing and routes, and explicitly warns that Squad and Zephyr Scale APIs are not similar.

blocked.label: Connect Zephyr Squad
blocked.description: Relay will not collect an access/secret key pair until the exact current request-signing and tenant-binding contract is pinned and tested.

blocked.label: Use Zephyr Squad API
blocked.description: Relay will not invent legacy JWT claims, canonical query hashing, endpoints or permissions from historical examples.

blocked.label: Use Zephyr Scale connector
blocked.description: SmartBear explicitly states that Squad and Zephyr Scale APIs are not similar, so credentials and routes cannot be reused.

approvalProfiles.label: Unavailable
approvalProfiles.description: No Zephyr Squad actions can be enabled until SmartBear's current Squad request-signing and endpoint contract is captured from an authoritative machine-readable source and accepted in staging.

runtimeSupport.description: No pinned current Zephyr Squad request-signing and endpoint contract is available to mount safely.

providerSetup.blocker: SmartBear's static Squad documentation covers access/secret key generation, while the distinct legacy API's exact current signing, base URL, routes and tenant-binding contract remain in a client-rendered Apiary reference and cannot be safely inferred from historical samples.
providerSetup.nextAction: The provider-console/API-contract lane must obtain SmartBear's current authoritative Squad API definition and confirm base URLs, JWT claims and canonical request hashing, access-key headers, user/Jira tenant binding, permissions, limits, rotation and revocation. Only then implement typed wrappers and run staging acceptance; do not reuse Zephyr Scale credentials or routes.

evidence.supports: SmartBear documents per-user Squad access and secret keys, states that they inherit the user's permissions, and documents secret-key regeneration, but does not specify the request-signing algorithm or API routes on this static page.
SmartBear explicitly states that Zephyr Squad and Zephyr/Zephyr Essential APIs are not similar and customers must review them separately.
SmartBear's linked legacy Squad API reference is client-rendered and does not expose a static authoritative contract to this code-only worker for safe schema and signing generation.
